_comment: DEMO / TEMPLATE for phcal_config.json. Copy this file to phcal_config.json (same directory, gitignored - never commit your real one) and fill in your own real values. base_dirs below are obviously-placeholder paths - replace with your own machine's real absolute paths. robots.candidates ESNs below are obviously-fake placeholders - replace with your own robot(s) real ESN(s). The candidates list supports any number of entries (detect-first probes each one at phcal startup) but this repo has only ever tested exactly 2.

robots._comment: Structure supports N candidates; tested at exactly 2 in this repo. First two entries map to Brobot 1 / Brobot 2 in that order.
